item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Iran’s president says US memorandum is best path out of stalled war
item.description: Iran's president on Sunday defended a memorandum of understanding with the United States as the best way out of a stalled war while the new head of the Islamic Republic's top security body took a more defiant stance, warning of retaliation if neighbors join U.S. threats to further sanction Tehran.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada, forcing thousands to evacuate
item.description: The fast-growing Hawk Fire was spreading toward neighborhoods in northwest Reno early Sunday, growing to more than 10,500 acres (42 sq. km.) Nearly 14,000 homes were ordered evacuated.
